name: UNBIASED
source: Salvation or Damnation? Measure the worth of human souls in this psychological anime & FMV visual novel about moral dilemma! Will you allow your prejudices to call the shots? Or can you remain unbiased?
translation: 救赎还是诅咒？在这部关于道德困境的心理动漫和FMV视觉小说中衡量人类灵魂的价值！你会允许你的偏见做主吗？或者你能保持不偏不倚吗？
